in_marathi.name: Sandeepkumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sandeepkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sandeepkumar means 'deep mind' in Sanskrit and Hindi. The name is derived from the words 'sandeep' meaning 'deep' and 'kumar' meaning 'mind'. This name is a perfect choice for parents who wish to bestow upon their child a name that represents strength, power, and spirituality.
